15	package storage
16	
17	import (
18		"sync"
19	
20		humanize "github.com/dustin/go-humanize"
21		"go.uber.org/zap"
22	
23		pb "go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3/etcdserverpb"
24		"go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3/storage/backend"
25	)
26	
27	const (
28		// DefaultQuotaBytes is the number of bytes the backend Size may
29		// consume before exceeding the space quota.
30		DefaultQuotaBytes = int64(2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) // 2GB
31		// MaxQuotaBytes is the maximum number of bytes suggested for a backend
32		// quota. A larger quota may lead to degraded performance.
33		MaxQuotaBytes = int64(8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024) // 8GB
34	)
35	
36	// Quota represents an arbitrary quota against arbitrary requests. Each request
37	// costs some charge; if there is not enough remaining charge, then there are
38	// too few resources available within the quota to apply the request.
39	type Quota interface {
40		// Available judges whether the given request fits within the quota.
41		Available(req any) bool
42		// Cost computes the charge against the quota for a given request.
43		Cost(req any) int
44		// Remaining is the amount of charge left for the quota.
45		Remaining() int64
46	}
47	
48	type passthroughQuota struct{}
49	
50	func (*passthroughQuota) Available(any) bool { return true }
51	func (*passthroughQuota) Cost(any) int       { return 0 }
52	func (*passthroughQuota) Remaining() int64   { return 1 }
53	
54	type BackendQuota struct {
55		be              backend.Backend
56		maxBackendBytes int64
57	}
58	
59	const (
60		// leaseOverhead is an estimate for the cost of storing a lease
61		leaseOverhead = 64
62		// kvOverhead is an estimate for the cost of storing a key's Metadata
63		kvOverhead = 256
64	)
65	
66	var (
67		// only log once
68		quotaLogOnce sync.Once
69	
70		DefaultQuotaSize = humanize.Bytes(uint64(DefaultQuotaBytes))
71		maxQuotaSize     = humanize.Bytes(uint64(MaxQuotaBytes))
72	)
73	
74	// NewBackendQuota creates a quota layer with the given storage limit.
75	func NewBackendQuota(lg *zap.Logger, quotaBackendBytesCfg int64, be backend.Backend, name string) Quota {
76		quotaBackendBytes.Set(float64(quotaBackendBytesCfg))
77		if quotaBackendBytesCfg < 0 {
78			// disable quotas if negative
79			quotaLogOnce.Do(func() {
80				lg.Info(
81					"disabled backend quota",
82					zap.String("quota-name", name),
83					zap.Int64("quota-size-bytes", quotaBackendBytesCfg),
84				)
85			})
86			return &passthroughQuota{}
87		}
88	
89		if quotaBackendBytesCfg == 0 {
90			// use default size if no quota size given
91			quotaLogOnce.Do(func() {
92				if lg != nil {
93					lg.Info(
94						"enabled backend quota with default value",
95						zap.String("quota-name", name),
96						zap.Int64("quota-size-bytes", DefaultQuotaBytes),
97						zap.String("quota-size", DefaultQuotaSize),
98					)
99				}
100			})
101			quotaBackendBytes.Set(float64(DefaultQuotaBytes))
102			return &BackendQuota{be, DefaultQuotaBytes}
103		}
104	
105		quotaLogOnce.Do(func() {
106			if quotaBackendBytesCfg > MaxQuotaBytes {
107				lg.Warn(
108					"quota exceeds the maximum value",
109					zap.String("quota-name", name),
110					zap.Int64("quota-size-bytes", quotaBackendBytesCfg),
111					zap.String("quota-size", humanize.Bytes(uint64(quotaBackendBytesCfg))),
112					zap.Int64("quota-maximum-size-bytes", MaxQuotaBytes),
113					zap.String("quota-maximum-size", maxQuotaSize),
114				)
115			}
116			lg.Info(
117				"enabled backend quota",
118				zap.String("quota-name", name),
119				zap.Int64("quota-size-bytes", quotaBackendBytesCfg),
120				zap.String("quota-size", humanize.Bytes(uint64(quotaBackendBytesCfg))),
121			)
122		})
123		return &BackendQuota{be, quotaBackendBytesCfg}
124	}
125	
126	func (b *BackendQuota) Available(v any) bool {
127		cost := b.Cost(v)
128		// if there are no mutating requests, it's safe to pass through
129		if cost == 0 {
130			return true
131		}
132		// TODO: maybe optimize Backend.Size()
133		return b.be.Size()+int64(cost) < b.maxBackendBytes
134	}
135	
136	func (b *BackendQuota) Cost(v any) int {
137		switch r := v.(type) {
138		case *pb.PutRequest:
139			return costPut(r)
140		case *pb.TxnRequest:
141			return costTxn(r)
142		case *pb.LeaseGrantRequest:
143			return leaseOverhead
144		default:
145			panic("unexpected cost")
146		}
147	}
148	
149	func costPut(r *pb.PutRequest) int { return kvOverhead + len(r.Key) + len(r.Value) }
150	
151	func costTxnReq(u *pb.RequestOp) int {
152		r := u.GetRequestPut()
153		if r == nil {
154			return 0
155		}
156		return costPut(r)
157	}
158	
159	func costTxn(r *pb.TxnRequest) int {
160		sizeSuccess := 0
161		for _, u := range r.Success {
162			sizeSuccess += costTxnReq(u)
163		}
164		sizeFailure := 0
165		for _, u := range r.Failure {
166			sizeFailure += costTxnReq(u)
167		}
168		if sizeFailure > sizeSuccess {
169			return sizeFailure
170		}
171		return sizeSuccess
172	}
173	
174	func (b *BackendQuota) Remaining() int64 {
175		return b.maxBackendBytes - b.be.Size()
176	}
177

package apply

import (
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	pb "go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3/etcdserverpb"
	"go.etcd.io/etcd/pkg/v3/traceutil"
	"go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3/etcdserver/errors"
	serverstorage "go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3/storage"
	"go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3/storage/backend"
)

type quotaApplierV3 struct {
	applierV3
	q serverstorage.Quota
}

func newQuotaApplierV3(lg *zap.Logger, quotaBackendBytesCfg int64, be backend.Backend, app applierV3) applierV3 {
	return &quotaApplierV3{app, serverstorage.NewBackendQuota(lg, quotaBackendBytesCfg, be, "v3-applier")}
}

func (a *quotaApplierV3) Put(p *pb.PutRequest) (*pb.PutResponse, *traceutil.Trace, error) {
	ok := a.q.Available(p)
	resp, trace, err := a.applierV3.Put(p)
	if err == nil && !ok {
		err = errors.ErrNoSpace
	}
	return resp, trace, err
}

func (a *quotaApplierV3) Txn(rt *pb.TxnRequest, skipRangeExecution bool) (*pb.TxnResponse, *traceutil.Trace, error) {
	ok := a.q.Available(rt)
	resp, trace, err := a.applierV3.Txn(rt, skipRangeExecution)
	if err == nil && !ok {
		err = errors.ErrNoSpace
	}
	return resp, trace, err
}

func (a *quotaApplierV3) LeaseGrant(lc *pb.LeaseGrantRequest) (*pb.LeaseGrantResponse, error) {
	ok := a.q.Available(lc)
	resp, err := a.applierV3.LeaseGrant(lc)
	if err == nil && !ok {
		err = errors.ErrNoSpace
	}
	return resp, err
}

content.text:
I fixed the quota bypass: `Put`s inside nested transactions now count against `--quota-backend-bytes` the same way as flat ones, in either branch and at any depth. The new tests pass.

**Cause:** in `server/storage/quota.go`, the function that works out a transaction's size only looked at direct `Put` operations. A nested `Txn` was treated as free, so a transaction containing only nested `Put`s was always allowed.

**Fix:** that function now also measures nested transactions, using the same rule as the top level: the larger of the `success` and `failure` branches. Both places that enforce the quota (the gRPC front end and the apply step) call this same function, so both now reject these requests with "database space exceeded".

**Tests:** I added `server/storage/quota_test.go`, since there was no quota test file before. It covers:
- `TestBackendQuotaCost`: size calculations for single puts, lease grants, empty and read-only transactions, and flat transactions (each branch, plus taking the larger branch). It also covers nested transactions in the outer `success` branch, the outer `failure` branch, the inner `failure` branch, mixed with a flat put, and nested several levels deep.
- `TestBackendQuotaAvailableNestedTxn`: sets a quota just above the current database size and checks that single puts, flat transactions and nested transactions (in both branches) are all rejected. A read-only nested transaction is still allowed.

**Verification:**
- With the fix temporarily removed, all 7 nested cases fail. With it restored, everything passes, which shows the tests catch this bug.
- `go test ./storage/ ./etcdserver/apply/ ./etcdserver/api/v3rpc/` passes, and `go vet ./storage/` is clean.

I didn't run the integration or end-to-end tests that start a real etcd server; I only ran the unit tests listed above.
